result:
I changed the flows reducer so live flows go to the front of the list when the order is reversed. I couldn't find a "reverse view order" option in the web frontend, so this rests on an assumption about what you meant. I didn't run the tests, the type-check or the linter, and I didn't add a test.

The only reverse-order state in the web frontend is `sort.desc` in `web/src/js/ducks/flows/index.ts`. The console UI has a `view_order_reversed` option, but nothing in `web/src` reads it. When no column is selected, `makeSort` compares every pair as equal, so `desc` did nothing. New flows were always appended at the end.

I treated "no sort column with `desc` set" as reversed arrival order. In that mode:
- **Live flows:** a new `flows/add` (or an `update` that makes a flow match the filter) is put at the front of the view. Before, it went at the end.
- **View rebuilds:** the initial fetch, search-filter updates and `setSort` with no column now all build the view newest-first.

The change is in `web/src/js/ducks/flows/index.ts`. I added the helpers `isReversedArrival`, `sortFlows` and `insertNewViewItem`. Behaviour with a sort column, or with no column and `desc` unset, is unchanged.

The header-click cycle in `FlowTableHead` never produces "no column with `desc` set", so nothing in the UI reaches the reversed mode today. If you meant the `view_order_reversed` server option, it would need to be wired into the frontend to set `desc` (for example by dispatching `setSort({ column: undefined, desc: true })`). Tell me if that's what you wanted and I'll add it.
